blocks.text:
After breakfast, visit Sugar Loaf.

The ascent begins at Red Beach. The cable car first takes you to Urca Hill and its first viewpoint, then to Sugar Loaf. From here you can see Copacabana, Ipanema, Guanabara Bay, the islands, the bridge to Niterói and Corcovado.

After the descent, the programme continues in central Rio. A visit to the Metropolitan Cathedral and a stop at the Selarón Steps, known for their colourful tiles, may be possible.

After the tour, you have free time to rest before Carnival.

In the evening, transfer to the Sambadrome for the Parade of Champions, featuring the best samba schools. Huge costumed processions, floats, music and dancing follow one another throughout the night. After the parade, transfer back to the hotel.

blocks.text:
Day 3 · After breakfast, a tour through the city to the station, where an eco-friendly train climbs through the Tijuca Forest, home to monkeys, exotic animals and birds, to the top of Corcovado. At 710 metres above sea level stands the symbol of Rio, the 38-metre statue of Christ the Redeemer, built in 1931, with a breathtaking panorama of the Rio–Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, Maracanã Stadium and Sugar Loaf.

**Excursion: Helicopter flight over Rio de Janeiro**

You can book a 9–10-minute flight circling the statue of Christ.

Price on request; transfer included.

Minimum group size: 4 people. Other customers may join your group.

In the evening, you can visit the Marius seafood restaurant; price on request.
